outlets.name: Ostbelgien Direkt
outlets.credible: German-language online daily news portal for the German-speaking Community of Belgium (Ostbelgien); independent DG newsroom used for local reporting and the region's restaurant/'Toprestaurants' and Fritten dossiers.

outlets.name: Ostbelgien.net
outlets.credible: Long-standing German-language East-Belgium tourism & gastronomy directory/portal with editorial venue profiles (restaurants, friteries, Konditoreien); corroborating local source, not a user-rating aggregator.

outlets.name: Made in Ostbelgien / Ostbelgien Info
outlets.credible: Official 'Made in Ostbelgien' platform of the German-speaking Community promoting regional producers/artisans (bakeries, chocolatiers); institutional DG source.

outlets.name: Ostbelgien Info
outlets.credible: Official German-speaking-Community information portal (IAWM/DG network) listing regional businesses and training firms; institutional DG source.

outlets.name: Eifel.de (Eifel Tourismus)
outlets.credible: Official Eifel Tourismus portal (German) covering the German-Belgian Hohes Venn-Eifel nature park, incl. Ostbelgien sights (Eupener Marktplatz, Wesertalsperre, Raeren).

outlets.name: Naturpark Hohes Venn-Eifel (DE side)
outlets.credible: Official German-Belgian nature-park authority page for the Hohes Venn-Eifel park; institutional source for the moorland reserve and its nature centres.

outlets.name: Parc naturel Hautes Fagnes-Eifel / Maison du Parc Botrange
outlets.credible: Official site of the Hautes Fagnes-Eifel nature park and its Maison du Parc (Naturparkzentrum) at Botrange; institutional authority on the reserve, trails and boardwalks.

outlets.name: Museum Vieille Montagne (MVM), Kelmis
outlets.credible: Official site of the Museum Vieille Montagne in Kelmis (successor of the Göhltalmuseum), the museum of Neutral-Moresnet zinc/industrial history; primary institutional source.

outlets.name: Töpfereimuseum Raeren
outlets.credible: Official site of the Raeren pottery museum in the 14th-c. Burg Raeren; the world's reference collection of Raeren stoneware (European Cultural Heritage Seal 2007); primary institutional source.

outlets.name: Raeren Tourismus
outlets.credible: Official tourism office of the municipality of Raeren (DG); institutional source for Burg Raeren and local sights.

outlets.name: Sport- & Freizeitzentrum Worriken (Bütgenbach)
outlets.credible: Official site of the ADEPS Worriken sports & holiday park on the Bütgenbach reservoir; primary source for the lake's activities.

outlets.name: Naturzentrum Haus Ternell
outlets.credible: Official nature-education centre of the German-speaking Community in the Hertogenwald at the foot of the Hohes Venn; institutional source.

outlets.name: IKOB — Museum für Zeitgenössische Kunst
outlets.credible: Official site of Eupen's contemporary-art museum (founded 1993); primary institutional source.

outlets.name: Burgenwelt.org
outlets.credible: Established German-language reference encyclopedia of castles/fortifications with sourced historical descriptions; corroborating documentary source for Burg Reinhardstein.

outlets.name: Varta-Guide
outlets.credible: German travel/leisure guide (Varta-Führer heritage) with editorial destination pages incl. St. Vith and Eupen in Ostbelgien; corroborating editorial source.

outlets.name: VRT NWS (German-language pages)
outlets.credible: Flemish public-service broadcaster's German-language news; national public-media coverage (used for the Chocolaterie Jacques closure).

outlets.name: Wikivoyage (de)
outlets.credible: Collaborative open travel guide (Wikimedia); encyclopedic corroboration for Eupen's old-town squares and cloth-merchant houses, cross-checked against official tourism sources.

outlets.name: GastroGuide Euregio
outlets.credible: German-language editorial dining guide for the Aachen/Euregio Maas-Rhein incl. Ostbelgien; corroborating editorial (not user-rating) source.
